messages.content: Return only the requested English text. Do not add a preface or word/token count.

Write a practical notice for a fictional neighborhood repair cafe: bring one broken item, take a numbered ticket, and collect it before volunteers leave. Avoid promotional language. Aim for approximately 60–85 English tokens.

message.content:
**Maple Street Repair Cafe: How It Works**

Bring one broken item per person. At the entrance, take a numbered ticket and attach it to your item. Volunteers will call numbers in order. Stay nearby during the repair if possible. Repairs are not guaranteed. Collect your item before volunteers leave at 4:00 p.m. Items left behind cannot be stored.
